title: Recovery Baseline and BPS Reintegration
layer: Native macOS Alpha / Clinical Assessment / Data Portability
to: Brandon Hatfield, LPC and the ConCOREdance project team
summary: ConCOREdance returns to a verified recovery baseline: complete encrypted backups include original attachments, client packets contain readable records and originals, failed saves remain recoverable, and the embedded client-linked BPS Assessment now supports encrypted autosave, deliberate review, immutable final records, and linked amendments.
